recipes.name: live_head_check
recipes.intent: Fetch, read local head, read upstream head, and record drift before any current-phase publication.
recipes.safety_rule: Read branch state only; no reset, rebase, force push, or broad stage.

recipes.name: json_parse_check
recipes.intent: Parse only current-phase JSON artifacts before staging.
recipes.safety_rule: Fail closed on malformed JSON and do not stage partial artifacts.

recipes.name: safety_pattern_guard
recipes.intent: Scan current-phase artifacts and staged diff for sensitive values, private key material, local capture paths, and raw capture references.
recipes.safety_rule: Fail closed on hits and rewrite the artifact rather than suppressing the guard.

recipes.name: exact_curated_stage
recipes.intent: Stage only the explicit current-phase file list.
recipes.safety_rule: Abort if any pre-existing staged file exists or if staged names differ from the curated list.

recipes.name: remote_equality_verify
recipes.intent: Fetch after push and verify local head equals upstream head.
recipes.safety_rule: Do not claim publication until equality is observed live.

recipes.name: drive_mirror_planned_only
recipes.intent: Document Drive mirror requirements without mutating Drive.
recipes.safety_rule: Connector mutation remains blocked without separate explicit approval and returned metadata receipt.
